purpose: A/A noise floor for future comparisons; no rejected candidate rerun
baselineScope: Frozen already validated main execution before shadow-library addition, actual automatic divisor1/Q4width32/E4R32 selection
perVisitStatistic: median warm decode elapsed milliseconds divided by31
predeclaredDecision: relativeSpread>0.05 means baseline reproducibility is inadequate for judging future sub5percent changes; prior failed gates stay failed
timingClaims: No performance improvement or Ollama ratio; A/A control only
separateGapTrace: Needs externally authored optional instrumentation in a separate run, not the A/A run; use one host monotonic clock at commit and wait return. Do not infer exact GPU completion gap from host wait return without clock/overhead validation. Flush-minus-GPU is not CPU busy time.
quietSource: Parent confirms Dokkabi developer and utility idle, no parent-owned Mac builds or benchmarks scheduled. Run after compilation/tests/reviews.
observationPlacement: Before and after each visit, outside decode windows; no process enumeration
matchedPrerequisites: A/A spread<=5%, all7visits retained, no recorded thermal warning or capacity limit, AC power with battery percentage at least20 if reported, no pageout/swapout growth. If not met skip matched attribution; do not claim noise eliminated.
